<title level="1" right="Rules">[Rituals](/Rules.aspx?ID=2255)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 389

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
A ritual is an esoteric and complex spell that anyone can cast. It takes much longer to cast a ritual than a normal spell, but rituals can have more powerful effects.
</column>

</column>

</row>
